habits.boundary_condition: Do not infer an ocean/view requirement from this habit; ocean view appears in only some supporting dialogues. Treat balcony as a preference unless the current request explicitly says it is mandatory.
habits.condition: Use when searching for or checking hotel room amenities; especially relevant when floor is unknown or the room is above the first floor.
habits.default_action: Ask for or verify that the hotel room has a balcony.
habits.exception_condition: A first-floor room may make the balcony unnecessary, based on one dialogue where the user explicitly relaxed the balcony request for first-floor placement.
habits.name: hotel_room_balcony_preference
habits.preference_value: Prefers a hotel room with a balcony when booking or evaluating rooms.
habits.rationale: All three independent hotel dialogues include the user asking for a balcony as a room feature. One dialogue later makes the balcony conditional on floor level, so the reusable habit should be soft and include that boundary rather than treating balcony as an absolute requirement.

source_evidence.contribution: Shows a balcony preference for higher-floor rooms and the first-floor exception that makes the habit soft rather than mandatory.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: We don't need a balcony if the room's on the first floor, but if it's on a higher floor then, you know, we can have a balcony.

source_evidence.contribution: Independently supports balcony as a desired hotel-room feature.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: The room must also have an ocean view, a balcony, a mini fridge, a king bed.

source_evidence.contribution: Independently supports looking for a hotel room with a balcony.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: Great. Now, for the rooms, I'm looking for a room that has a balcony, cable TV. Perhaps a coffee maker.
